title: A normalization residue quotient has length equal to canonical inertia degree
statement: Let K, E and L be fields with compatible algebra structures K → E → L, with L/E finite-dimensional and separable. Let v be a project place of E over K and w a project place of L over K satisfying hw : w.restrict E = v. Put A = v.toValuationSubring, B = Place.integralClosureAt L v and q = (Place.fiberCenter L v hw).asIdeal. Then length_A(B/q) = (w.inertiaDeg E : ℕ∞), where the quotient has its canonical A-action and inertia degree uses the project's canonical restriction residue algebra. No principal-divisor hypothesis is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (K E L : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L] [Algebra E L] [IsScalarTower K E L] [FiniteDimensional E L] [Algebra.IsSeparable E L] (v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E) (w : AlgebraicCurve.Place K L) (hw : w.restrict E = v), Module.length v.toValuationSubring (AlgebraicCurve.Place.integralClosureAt L v ⧸ (AlgebraicCurve.Place.fiberCenter L v hw).asIdeal) = (w.inertiaDeg E : ℕ∞)
